acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira Glass talks to Bim Adewunmi about her understanding of delight through American pop culture and the summer she spent in the US as a 19-year-old. Ira then hands the show over to Bim as guest host.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Bim talks to poet Ross Gay, whose book inspired today’s show, about the discipline and rigor of seeking and holding onto delight.
acts.title: The Job Of Delight

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Robyn Semien captures a special morning for her five-year-old son, Cole, who is doing something delightful for the very first time: he’s getting to ride the school bus.
acts.title: The Squeals On The Bus

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Producer Miki Meek speaks to Noriko Meek, her 72-year-old mother, about discovering delight late in life.
acts.title: Mrs. Meek Shall Inherit The Earth

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Producer Dana Chivvis follows the night zookeeper at the Denver Zoo as she doles out snacks and tucks the animals in.
acts.title: The Elephant In The Bedroom

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc: What happens when a dealer of delight gets depressed? Podcast host Tracy Clayton talks to Bim Adewunmi about the road back.
acts.title: Delight At The End Of The Tunnel
